purpose: Retrospective test of a trajectory-coherent layer objective (C2 candidate after tfdiag). tfdiag (26065573): the W2 velocity error is a per-step bias in nearly the same direction at every denoising step (|sum_i delta_i (v_S - v_T)|^2 = 7.1 x the sum of the step energies, 6.4-7.5 over all 80 samples), and its sum lines up with the rollout future error (cos 0.65). If the same weight error repeats over the 10 video steps, a layer's contribution to the future is ~ dW sum_i delta_i x_i per token, so the objective is tr(dW H_traj dW^T) with H_traj = sum_token (sum_i delta_i x_i)(sum_i delta_i x_i)^T instead of H_U = mean over calls of x x^T. Does it rank the held-out future NMSE of the W2 arms we already have, where H_U does not? No requantization: proxies of saved weights.
calibration: C80 (cases 2000-2079), sampler seed index 0, runtime.infer: the queries and path H_U was collected on (A16 baselines prep_worker)
layers: the 306 video-expert target Linears (the future comes from the video stage only); the action expert and proprio_encoder are left out
calls: per query each video Linear runs once per video denoising step (10) and once in the action stage's video prefill; a layer with exactly 11 calls is stepped: calls 0-9 are steps i with the scheduler's delta_i, call 10 (prefill) is left out; a layer with any other count is unstepped and enters with all its calls, unaccumulated, in both variants. The counts come from a dry query and every query is checked against them

variants.U: H_U from the A16 baselines' prep (mean x x^T over all calls of the C80 queries)
variants.S: steps, incoherent: sum over tokens and steps of delta_i^2 x_i x_i^T (same calls and weights as J, no cross-step terms)
variants.J: trajectory: sum over tokens of (sum_i delta_i x_i)(sum_i delta_i x_i)^T, token = the same row of the call's input at every step

proxy: per layer p = tr(dW H dW^T) / tr(W H W^T), dW = W_arm - W_master (FP32); per arm the weight-count-weighted mean of p over the video layers (primary) and the plain mean (reported). Coherence per layer: kappa = tr(dW H_J dW^T) / tr(dW H_S dW^T) on the raw sums (10 if every step's error adds in phase with uniform delta, 1 if uncorrelated), and the same for W
arm_sources: file: <root>/quantized/<dir>/weights/<index>.pt (baseline = A16 baselines results, new = this experiment's results); gate: the base arm with the layers of results/gate/selection.json hosts[gate_host].layers taken from the selected arm (G) or results/gate/<gate_host>/weights (O), as gate_worker.install; lowrank: the base arm plus U V from results/lowrank/<arm>/factors.pt (BF16 factors, as the deployed branch computes them in FP32)
heldout: results/heldout/<arm>.json overall: future_latent_nmse (target), mixed_loss and first10motor_rmse (reported)

closed_loop.basis: LIBERO-Plus 280 successes from the A16 baselines and jobs 26043905, 26046240, 26050625, 26050310; reported, not gating

checks.basis: the mean over all calls of x x^T collected here on these layers must reproduce the baselines' H_U (relative Frobenius difference): same queries, same path, same scaling

reading.primary: Spearman rho between an arm's weighted video-layer proxy and its held-out future NMSE over the 11 QTIP arms (same host, different methods: the arms the host gap cannot sort); pooled over all 19 arms reported
reading.go: rho_J >= go_rho_min and rho_J - rho_U >= go_gain_min: H_traj ranks the future error where H_U does not; next, QTIP W2 requantized on the saved H_traj (results/traj/hessians), held-out future <= 0.9 x U, then the closed loop
reading.coherence: the claim that the cross-step terms do it needs rho_J - rho_S >= coherence_gain_min; otherwise the gain comes from keeping only the denoising-step calls
reading.no_go: rho_J below go_rho_min or within go_gain_min of rho_U: a layer objective built on step-accumulated activations does not see the future error the arms differ in

outcome: no-go (26066187, gdev, 42 min): over the 11 QTIP arms rho(future NMSE) = 0.682 for H_U, H_S and H_traj alike (mixed 0.873, motor 0.709, closed loop 0.447 for all three); pooled 19 arms 0.686 / 0.686 / 0.677. H_all reproduces H_U bitwise. Proxies are near-proportional across arms (H_S/H_U 0.96-0.97, H_traj/H_U 0.85-0.89): master kappa median 9.70 of 10 (90% of layers >= 8.98), quantization-error kappa 8.69-8.95 over the arms. Per token position the video layers see nearly the same input at all 10 steps, so H_traj ~ const x H_U and the cross-step coherence tfdiag measured is already in H_U.
save: H_traj per stepped video layer, mean over tokens and queries, results/traj/hessians/<index>.pt (dict module, rows, hessian, kind) for the requantization a go leads to

allocation.time_basis: load ~8 min; 80 C80 queries per memory pass at ~4 s (two FP32 accumulators per layer, 65 GB for the video layers: 2-4 passes); proxies of 13 distinct weight sets under 3 Hessians ~1 PFLOP; H_traj writes 33 GB: ~45 min
